formal_statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, C.size ≤ 27 ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, g.inputs = [a, b] ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a < 14 + j ∧ b < 14 + j) ∧ (∀ x : Fin 14 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u t : Fin 7, (u = t ∨ u = t + 1 ∨ u = t + 3) ∧ x (Fin.castAdd 7 u) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd 7 t) = true) ∧ ∃ p l : Fin 7, (p = l ∨ p = l + 1 ∨ p = l + 3) ∧ (∃ v : ℕ → Bool, (∀ my : Fin 7, v my.val = false ∧ v (7 + my.val) = decide (my = l)) ∧ (∀ (ky : ℕ) (hy : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (cy dy : ℕ), C.gates[ky]? = some hy → hy.inputs = [cy, dy] → (hy.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → v (14 + ky) = (((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun iy : Fin 14 => decide (iy = Fin.castAdd 7 p)))).getD cy false && v dy) || (v cy && (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ey : Fin 14 => decide (ey = Fin.castAdd 7 p)))).getD dy false))) ∧ (hy.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → v (14 + ky) = (v cy || v dy))) ∧ v C.output = false) ∧ (∃ w : ℕ → Bool, (∀ mx : Fin 7, w mx.val = decide (mx = p) ∧ w (7 + mx.val) = false) ∧ (∀ (kx : ℕ) (hx : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (cx dx : ℕ), C.gates[kx]? = some hx → hx.inputs = [cx, dx] → (hx.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → w (14 + kx) = (((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ix : Fin 14 => decide (ix = Fin.natAdd 7 l)))).getD cx false && w dx) || (w cx && (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ex : Fin 14 => decide (ex = Fin.natAdd 7 l)))).getD dx false))) ∧ (hx.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → w (14 + kx) = (w cx || w dx))) ∧ w C.output = false)
plain_statement: Fano plane: points and lines 0..6, line l holds points l, l+1, l+3 mod 7; inputs x_0..x_6 then y_0..y_6; F is true iff some x_p, y_l with p on l are both true. For an AND/OR circuit and incident (p, l), g0 of a wire is its value with only x_p true; g1: y_m is 1 iff m = l, x inputs 0, AND(a, b) gives (a0 b1) or (a1 b0), OR gives a1 or b1. (p, l) is in E_y if the output's g1 is 1; E_x swaps x and y. Some circuit of at most 27 gates, each AND or OR of two distinct earlier wires, computes F and has an incident (p, l) in neither. Conjecture.
title: Fano plane: a circuit of at most 27 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
